evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This story targets content-identification/fingerprinting search; no other story expresses the same exact requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Search driven by the user's profile is a distinct requirement compared to other search methods in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: This specifies collaborative/similarity-based discovery (other users) which differs from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: This story is about finding items similar to a given video (content-similarity) and is distinct from other search approaches.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Using enriched metadata and image tags is a different search technique and not a duplicate of other stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This upload-and-tagging pipeline requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnail sequences is a distinct UI/UX requirement not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Requesting info about similar video items/segments is a distinct requirement and is the earlier occurrence of this theme.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-008 (same actor/context/goal) with only a minor wording change ('perceptually'), not a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: This is a recommendation feature based on similar profiles and differs from other search/recommend stories by scope.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations tied to local news events are a different triggering signal than other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and related info is a distinct detection/metadata requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification differs meaningfully from person or brand/logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster logo identification is a distinct detection requirement (different entity type).

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is different from persons, products, or logos—unique entity detection requirement.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-based reverse-recommendation (image → videos) is distinct from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geolocation/map-based discovery is a unique context-specific requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct technical approach compared to other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation validation/editing is a specific admin task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotating news segments and topic extraction is distinct from segmentation editing.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detecting edited audio is a specific quality/forensics check distinct from other audio tasks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content-moderation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering using low-level asset information is a distinct method from other prefilter stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a unique legal/compliance requirement not repeated.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering using high-level metadata/tags is meaningfully different from low-level prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Assessing picture interestingness based on multiple signals is a distinct analytics requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/comments is a distinct workflow/alerting requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typing/classification is a unique requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification for Galaxy Zoo is distinct from other project stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific 'no animals' detection for Snapshot Serengeti is distinct from other detection tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Image-series detection for timestamp malfunction is a specific technical requirement unique in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from 'no animals' detection and other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., pose/behavior) differs from species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a separate requirement from species/attribute detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is a project-specific, distinct detection task.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific 'no classifiable plankton' detection differs from other 'no items' stories by context.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a distinct measurement requirement within the Plankton Portal context.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for plankton is different from segmentation, detection of absence, or size/orientation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis for video reduction is a unique requirement for that project.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying time) is a specific analysis requirement differing from motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Detecting disaster-related features in satellite images is a unique remote-sensing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by volunteer experience is a distinct analytics requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Image artifact prefiltering is a distinct preprocessing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient-object detection is a separate detection task not covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio cleaning (noise removal) is a unique processing requirement distinct from audio assessment tasks.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar whale calls is a species-specific audio clustering requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct analytical task from grouping calls.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of interruption is a separate requirement from the mode or content of interruption.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption modality is a distinct decision dimension (mode) and not a duplicate of knowing when.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to educate is a different intent (education vs interruption) and is unique.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education modality is distinct from timing or content-selection stories.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the specific educational content is a distinct requirement from timing or modality.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a unique monitoring requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Timing Zoonibot comments is a distinct automation/trigger requirement separate from comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Deciding when to provide explanations (a specific type of Zoonibot action) differs from general comment timing.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content-generation for Zoonibot is a distinct requirement (what to say) not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject grouping by similarity is a general clustering requirement unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation to volunteers is a distinct recommendation use-case not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Admin-facing article summarization for reuse is a unique requirement in the backlog.
